cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make the Test Test You
cards.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Give up your prize seat to prove you're on my side. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you give up yours too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Mine is essential for maintaining perspective.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I may have designed a test I wasn't planning to take.

mechanism: A leads a boycott-style commitment test by demanding B surrender comfort, then negotiates a demonstration that preserves A own seat.
confusable: Simple selfishness lacks an A-imposed loyalty test that B redirects to expose what A will not risk.
comparison: The overnight alternative exposes sleep; this one makes visible solidarity collide with A comfort and front-row privilege.
seedUse: Prize-seat seed gives the reciprocal sacrifice; new protest context makes being on A side intelligible.
